name: OpenVibe.Pics
description: OpenVibe.Pics will be the picture home of the OpenVibe network: quick uploads and share links with or without an account, albums and galleries, image processing and optimisation served from a shared CDN, and AI image tools, an open and modular alternative to Imgur that is also usable through the OpenVibe API.

pillars.title: Upload & share
pillars.text: Drop a picture, get a link, with or without an account.

pillars.title: Processing
pillars.text: Resize, convert and optimise on the fly, cached close to viewers.

pillars.title: AI image tools
pillars.text: Describe, tag, edit and generate with the network's shared AI.

keywords: openvibe pics, image hosting, image upload, imgur alternative, image cdn, ai image tools
